review: The Pinky apprentice Sinclair is the first Poise self-sufficient ID we’ve gotten in a long time, ever since the Full-Stop Duo. However, his pros do not end here, as on top of that, he has one of the highest raw Physical Damage in the game at the moment of his release. Let’s dive into his kit! Starting with his passives, which he has 2 of. The first one is an always active passive, granting him his unique effect “Moonlit Azure Blade” on turn end. This unique effect allows him to gain Shield, Crit DMG Up and enhance his skills. On top of that, if he only used Defensive Skills, on combat start, he will heal 5 SP and gain 1 Slash Power Up next turn. This effect strongly synergises with his Defensive Skill effects.
